findings.evidence: SPEC-0003 section 8 SR-005 row: "Gap (not met), unchanged: other error bodies and the error.unhandled log (7; SPEC-0002 D-1)". Other error bodies are not yet the fixed SR-005 body and unhandled exceptions are not logged as error.unhandled.
SPEC-0003 section 8 SR-022 row: "Gap on s3:TlsVersion is unchanged (SPEC-0002 D-3, out of scope)". The bucket policy has no deny for TLS below 1.2 and there is no TLS 1.1 handshake test.

SPEC-0003 section 8 SR-024 row: "Gap (not met), unchanged: the mandatory events other than this one are not emitted by the current code (out of scope)". Events such as input.rejected and error.unhandled are not emitted.
